stem.en: With all 4 strips in wheat, the farmer's plot gives combination A: 0 kg of barley and 100 kg of wheat. With one strip switched to barley, it gives combination B: 25 kg of barley and 90 kg of wheat. How many kilograms of wheat does the farmer give up to get those 25 kg of barley?

explanation.en: Wheat falls from 100 kg at A to 90 kg at B. So the first 25 kg of barley costs 100 − 90 = 10 kg of wheat. That 10 kg of wheat is the opportunity cost of the first 25 kg of barley.

hints.en: Compare only the wheat at A and at B: 100 kg becomes how much?
